purpose: Add a tabbed structure to the Settings modal and render the Devices tab that fetches own key packages (local IDB union relay-fetched kind-30443) and provides forget-self / forget-sibling flows via the ForgetDeviceAPI seam.

public_api.name: SettingsModal
public_api.signature: function SettingsModal({ isOpen, onClose, pubkey, authMethod, onSignOut }: SettingsModalProps): JSX.Element
public_api.description: Dialog with two tabs: 'Connection' (existing npub QR + copy) and 'Devices' (new DevicesTab). Accepts onSignOut as a new required prop wired from app/page.tsx.

public_api.name: DevicesTab
public_api.description: Internal component (separate file src/components/DevicesTab.tsx). Calls useMarmot() to get client, signer, relays, clientId, pubkey. Fetches own KP events from client.keyPackages.list() and client.network.request(relays, keyPackageFilters([pubkey])). Renders per-device rows with Forget buttons and confirmation dialogs.

owned_data: React state for in-flight progress (isInProgress, progressMsg)
React state for confirmation dialog open/close per slot
test_targets: AC-UI-1 through AC-UI-6 (structural + testid coverage verified by S6 e2e)

architect_decisions.rationale: The primitive already existed in the codebase (first consumer in SettingsModal); no new dependency introduced.

architect_decisions.choice: Union of client.keyPackages.list() (local IDB) and client.network.request(relays, keyPackageFilters([pubkey])) (relay kind-30443 events), deduped by slot identifier
architect_decisions.rationale: The ratchet tree only exposes admitted leaves; the relay fetch captures all KPs the user has ever published, including pre-invite ones — matches AC-UI-2 exactly.

architect_decisions.choice: AlertDialog from src/components/ui/alert-dialog.tsx — two separate instances: SelfForgetDialog and SiblingForgetDialog
architect_decisions.rationale: AlertDialog has built-in accessible blocking semantics; splitting self/sibling into separate inner components keeps each dialog's text and testids distinct.

architect_decisions.choice: Generic boolean inFlight state drives a single spinner row ('Removing from groups…') and disables all Forget buttons while any operation is in progress
architect_decisions.rationale: Per-group granularity would require an onProgress callback in the S3 forgetSelfDevice/forgetSiblingDevice API, which is out of S4 scope; v1 accepts the generic spinner per the spawn brief.

architect_decisions.choice: Prop-drilled: app/page.tsx passes onSignOut={handleDisconnect} → SettingsModal → DevicesTab → forgetSelfDevice(client, signer, relays, onSignOut)
architect_decisions.rationale: DevicesTab calls useMarmot() directly for client/signer/relays/clientId/pubkey; SettingsModal does not duplicate that hook call. onSignOut is the only prop threading required.

architect_decisions.choice: Separate file src/components/DevicesTab.tsx (pre-authored by prior architect spawn); SettingsModal imports it
architect_decisions.rationale: Separation avoids one 200+ line component becoming 500+ lines and keeps the two concerns (tab shell vs device list logic) independently readable.

design_decisions.tab_primitive: Reuse src/components/ui/tabs.tsx — <Tabs>, <TabsList>, <TabsTrigger>, <TabsContent>. First consumer of this primitive.
design_decisions.devices_tab_placement: Separate file src/components/DevicesTab.tsx (not inlined) for readability; SettingsModal imports it.
design_decisions.data_source: client.keyPackages.list() (local IDB, ListedKeyPackage[]) merged with client.network.request(relays, keyPackageFilters([pubkey])) (relay kind-30443 events). Union deduped by slot identifier. The local clientId row is always included even if no published events exist.
design_decisions.marmot_access: DevicesTab calls useMarmot() directly (not prop-drilled from SettingsModal) for client, signer, relays, clientId, pubkey. SettingsModal only adds onSignOut as a new prop.
design_decisions.confirmation_dialog: AlertDialog from src/components/ui/alert-dialog.tsx — separate instances for self-forget and sibling-forget flows.
design_decisions.progress_indicator: Generic spinner + 'Removing from groups...' message via isInProgress boolean state. Per-group granularity omitted (v1) because forgetSelfDevice/forgetSiblingDevice expose no onProgress callback, and changing the S3 contract is out of scope.
design_decisions.on_sign_out_wiring: app/page.tsx passes onSignOut={handleDisconnect} to <SettingsModal> as prop; SettingsModal threads it to <DevicesTab onSignOut={onSignOut}>; DevicesTab passes it to forgetSelfDevice(..., onSignOut).
design_decisions.test_coverage_handoff: AC-UI-1..6 dialog behavior and data-testid selectors covered by S6/S7 e2e tests. No vitest component tests added (mocking useMarmot and network in a JSDOM environment is low-value for these integration-heavy flows).
